metadata.article_title: Persons deemed to be public servants.

article.title: Persons deemed to be public servants.
article.content:
156Persons deemed to be public servants.

Section 156  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 118 of the Act
All persons discharging functions under this Act shall be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of section 21 of the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860).
